pages.text: The Energy Aggregator converts large amounts of Akaishi Energy into materials.$(br2)$(bold)Two uses:$(reset)$(li)10M energy + 1 Netherite Ingot → 1 Akaishi Ingot$(li)10M energy + 1 Geode → the Geode one grade higher (Flawed → Normal → Pristine → Perfect)$(br2)It has a 200M energy buffer and accepts power only; energy is piped in and the material is inserted, after which it operates automatically.

$(bold)Note: the Aggregator is the only method of mass-producing Akaishi Ingots.$(reset) It gates all downstream content: Akaishi equipment, machine components and the industrial chain.$(br2)Geode upgrades also use it; a Flawed Geode upgraded to Perfect multiplies the crystal farm yield several times.$(br2)If power is insufficient, add generators, connect them into one grid with $(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l) and store the output in Energy Cells.
Ingot uses and the Geode farm are covered in $(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:catalyst)Catalyst$(/l).
